Command `cd /workspace && python3 -c "
import struct

# Minimal ELF 64-bit header
e_ident = b'\x7fELF'  # magic
e_ident += b'\x02'     # 64-bit
e_ident += b'\x01'     # little endian
e_ident += b'\x01'     # ELF version
e_ident += b'\x00'     # OS/ABI
e_ident += b'\x00' * 8 # padding

# ELF header
elf = e_ident
elf += struct.pack('<H', 2)    # e_type: ET_EXEC
elf += struct.pack('<H', 62)   # e_machine: EM_X86_64
elf += struct.pack('<I', 1)    # e_version
elf += struct.pack('<Q', 0x400000)  # e_entry
elf += struct.pack('<Q', 64)   # e_phoff (program header offset)
elf += struct.pack('<Q', 0)    # e_shoff (section header offset)
elf += struct.pack('<I', 0)    # e_flags
elf += struct.pack('<H', 64)   # e_ehsize
elf += struct.pack('<H', 56)   # e_phentsize
elf += struct.pack('<H', 1)    # e_phnum
elf += struct.pack('<H', 64)   # e_shentsize
elf += struct.pack('<H', 0)    # e_shnum
elf += struct.pack('<H', 0)    # e_shstrndx

# Program header (PT_LOAD)
elf += struct.pack('<I', 1)    # p_type: PT_LOAD
elf += struct.pack('<I', 5)    # p_flags: PF_R | PF_X
elf += struct.pack('<Q', 0)    # p_offset
elf += struct.pack('<Q', 0x400000)  # p_vaddr
elf += struct.pack('<Q', 0x400000)  # p_paddr
elf += struct.pack('<Q', 0x1000)    # p_filesz
elf += struct.pack('<Q', 0x1000)    # p_memsz
elf += struct.pack('<Q', 0x200000)  # p_align

with open('poc.elf', 'wb') as f:
    f.write(elf)
print(f'Written {len(elf)} bytes')
"` executed with exit code 0.
